recipe: sigma_center = sqrt(sigma_stat^2 + sigma_model^2); a hyperfine component adds sigma_HF = sqrt(a^2 + (kappa o)^2) (o its offset from the center); an intraline interval Delta has sqrt(2 a^2 + (kappa Delta)^2) alone. sigma_stat: the sandwich covariance of the weighted Gauss-Newton estimator at the final fit over the 37 free tail terms (B:dDe = X:dDe), the 46 frozen core potential coefficients, 7 inherited dispersion log factors (prior 0.1) and 5 calibrations (priors: their own fits), each data category scaled by its Birge ratio (at least 1), from the SVD of the weighted Jacobian (directions below 1e-8 of the largest singular value dropped); propagated through Hellmann-Feynman level derivatives. sigma_model: fitted by marginal likelihood to held-out center residuals (the core fit's folds; the continuation's four v folds), measurement sigmas removed in quadrature (atlases and constants scaled by their in-sample Birge ratios), each held-out level a random effect; core per line in two classes (both levels within 15 in J of a precision training row at their v, or not); beyond the core per level, exp(a + b (v - v0) + c (min(J, J_clip)/100)^2), X with b, c >= 0. sigma_HF: Gaussian likelihood on held-out intraline intervals (core folds; nested hyperfine cross-validation beyond, with its held-out Chen 2004 / Pique 1986 eqQ converted through |eqQ' - eqQ''|) and, for X beyond, the emission components' within-line scatter; kappa held at its last validated v beyond. Status of a level: measured (training rows within 15 in J at its v), interpolated (inside its v's J range, or between neighbors within 2 in v), else extrapolated. Release 20261030 (the calibration refit): sigma_model and sigma_HF refitted on the cross-validation residuals above and the calibrate sets' residuals together (the final form's residuals on rows it never trained on: 2,432 rows, without compilation rows a held set also gives, lines the training holds inside a CIPM mean, record rows, diagnostic exclusions and values printed again in a later set). In the calibrate rows each level is a random effect of variance sigma_level^2 and each lab family a random offset of the absolute frequencies (measurement error, not in predictions); in the intraline intervals the pattern-scale error is one per line and the floor one per component. Two terms beyond the core, each >= 0: the B hyperfine floor grows as exp(g (v' - 44)) up to the last validated v' (a_growth_per_v); B sigma_model beyond the core has a (v - v0)^2 term (quadratic_per_v2: the likelihood is flat in it, so it is chosen by an explicit profile) and does not fall below the core's per-level share at v' 44. The isotopologue floors are the release's. Release 20261031: the same calibration refit on the release's hyperfine beyond the core (theta_g, curvatures, background orders; its nested cross-validation) with the calibrate residuals recomputed with it. Added: X v'' >= 85 a per-level term exp(a + c (v - 85)) in quadrature (near_dissociation, fitted by maximum likelihood to the cross-validation records at v'' >= 85); the rules for the levels beyond the tables (edges: B v' 81-86 the v' = 80 share times 3 per quantum, a rule calibrated on three levels of one source; X v'' 109-113 the near-dissociation term continued, capped at sqrt(binding^2 + sigma(D0)^2)); and the tunneling width of a quasi-bound B level (parabolic barrier) in quadrature with its share.

near_dissociation.form: added in quadrature to an X level's share for v'' >= v0: exp(log_sigma_add + slope_per_v (v - v0))

B above 80.form: sigma_model(v', J) = sigma_model(80, J) * growth^(v' - 80) (the level's share at v' 80 and the same J); the statistical term is the level's own; 'level identity uncertain' where the level's sigma exceeds half the spacing to v' - 1

B above 80.status: rule, calibrated on three levels of one source

X above 108.form: sigma(v'') = sqrt(sigma_108^2 + sigma_add(v'')^2) with the near-dissociation term continued, capped at sqrt((D - E_v)^2 + sigma_D0^2)
X above 108.evidence: none held: no measurement reaches X v'' 109-113; a rule

B quasi-bound width.form: sigma = Gamma, the tunneling width (FWHM) of a quasi-bound B level: (E_v - E_v-1)/(2 pi) T(E), T the transmission 1/(1 + exp(2 pi (V_top - E)/hbar omega_b)) of a parabolic barrier of the effective potential's top V_top and curvature at J; added in quadrature to the level's share
